subject: The 3AM spiral that saved Sarah
preview_text: How one user turned her darkest moment into a breakthrough with Fresh Start
body_paragraphs: It was 3AM. Sarah was staring at her ceiling, heart racing, phone in hand. She was about to text her ex the way she had every night for a week. But instead, she opened Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy and hit the emergency mode. That one decision changed everything.

She expected a robotic response, but instead, the AI therapist said something that stopped her cold: 'You're not weak for feeling this. You're human. But you deserve better than a 3AM text that will only hurt you more.' Sarah broke down, but for the first time, it wasn't from pain. It was relief—because someone, even an AI, understood.

What saved her wasn't magic. It was the same feature you have right now: emergency mode. It's designed for those moments when your thoughts spiral, when you feel alone, and when your fingers itch to reach out. It gives you coping strategies tailored to your breakup type, and a safe space to vent without judgment. Sarah used it every night for a week. Then every other night. Then not at all.

Now she's 60 days no-contact, and she says the app taught her she was whole before him. Open Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy tonight, and if you feel that 3AM pull, tap the emergency mode. You've got this. P.S. The mood tracker is proof you're healing even when it doesn't feel like it—Sarah's chart went from red to green in 30 days.
